name: establishment of sister chromatid cohesion N-acetyltransferase 2

function.text: ESCO2 encodes n-acetyltransferase ESCO2. Annotated molecular activities include N-acetyltransferase activity and acetyltransferase activity. It participates in post-translational protein acetylation and sister chromatid cohesion.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Roberts-SC phocomelia syndrome (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
